pvp.title: PvP
query: SELECT TOP (10) ud.char_id AS player_id, ud.char_name AS player_name, ud.Duel AS pvp, ud.PK AS pk, ud.gender AS sex, CASE WHEN ud.login > ISNULL(ud.logout, '1900-01-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS online, ud.use_time AS time_in_game, PL.name AS clan_name, PL.skill_level AS clan_level, ud.class AS class_id, ud.Lev AS [level], ClanCrest.bitmap AS clan_crest, AllianceCrest.bitmap AS alliance_crest

FROM dbo.user_data AS ud LEFT JOIN dbo.Pledge AS PL ON PL.pledge_id = ud.pledge_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Pledge_Crest AS ClanCrest ON ClanCrest.crest_id = PL.pledge_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Alliance AS A ON A.id = PL.alliance_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Pledge_Crest AS AllianceCrest ON AllianceCrest.crest_id = A.crest_id
WHERE ud.account_id > 0 ORDER BY ud.Duel DESC

clan.title: Clans
query: SELECT TOP (10) PL.castle_id, PL.root_name_value AS reputation_score, PL.ruler_id AS leader_id, R.char_name AS player_name, R.Duel AS pvp, R.PK AS pk, CASE WHEN R.login > ISNULL(R.logout, '1900-01-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS online, R.use_time AS time_in_game, R.gender AS sex, PL.name AS clan_name, PL.skill_level AS clan_level, ClanCrest.bitmap AS clan_crest, AllianceCrest.bitmap AS alliance_crest,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.user_data AS m WHERE m.pledge_id = PL.pledge_id AND m.account_id > 0) AS clan_count_members

FROM dbo.Pledge AS PL LEFT JOIN dbo.user_data AS R ON R.char_id = PL.ruler_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Pledge_Crest AS ClanCrest ON ClanCrest.crest_id = PL.pledge_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Alliance AS A ON A.id = PL.alliance_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Pledge_Crest AS AllianceCrest ON AllianceCrest.crest_id = A.crest_id
ORDER BY PL.root_name_value DESC

castle.title: Castle
query: SELECT c.id AS castle_id, c.tax_rate AS tax, PL.name AS clan_name, PL.skill_level AS clan_level, R.char_name AS player_name, ClanCrest.bitmap AS clan_crest, AllianceCrest.bitmap AS alliance_crest

FROM dbo.castle AS c LEFT JOIN dbo.Pledge AS PL ON PL.pledge_id = c.pledge_id LEFT JOIN dbo.user_data AS R ON R.char_id = PL.ruler_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Pledge_Crest AS ClanCrest ON ClanCrest.crest_id = PL.pledge_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Alliance AS A ON A.id = PL.alliance_id LEFT JOIN dbo.Pledge_Crest AS AllianceCrest ON AllianceCrest.crest_id = A.crest_id
ORDER BY c.id

online_count.title: Online Count
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS online FROM dbo.user_data WHERE login IS NOT NULL AND (logout IS NULL OR login > logout)

character_online.title: Character Online
query: SELECT CASE WHEN login > ISNULL(logout, '1900-01-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS online FROM dbo.user_data WHERE char_name = ?

account_characters.title: Account Characters

add_item.title: Add Item
add_item.description: Выдача через dbo.user_delivery: сервер сам выдаёт предметы онлайн-персонажу (lin_LoadUserDelivery берёт строки со status = 0), кик не нужен. Аргументы: char_id, item_id, count, enchant. Пустой запрос = выдача через CacheD с киком.
query: DECLARE @char_id int = ?, @item_id int = ?, @quantity bigint = ?, @enchant int = ?;
INSERT INTO dbo.user_delivery (account_id, char_id, account_name, char_name, item_id, quantity, enchant, status)
SELECT account_id, char_id, account_name, char_name, @item_id, @quantity, @enchant, 0 FROM dbo.user_data WHERE char_id = @char_id;
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 RAISERROR('user_delivery: character not found', 16, 1);

account_password.title: Account Password
query: UPDATE au SET password = CONVERT(binary(16), ?, 1) FROM dbo.user_auth AS au JOIN dbo.sphere_account_email AS e ON e.account = au.account WHERE au.account = ? AND e.email = ?

account_change_email.title: Change Account Email
query: DECLARE @new nvarchar(255) = ?, @login nvarchar(50) = ?, @old nvarchar(255) = ?;
MERGE dbo.sphere_account_email WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t
USING (SELECT account FROM dbo.user_account WHERE account = @login) AS s ON t.account = s.account
WHEN MATCHED AND ISNULL(t.email, '') = @old AND @new <> '' THEN UPDATE SET email = @new
WHEN MATCHED AND ISNULL(t.email, '') = @old AND @new = '' THEN DELETE
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET AND @old = '' AND @new <> '' THEN INSERT (account, email) VALUES (s.account, @new);
account_change_email.description: В PTS у аккаунта нет e-mail: привязка хранится в таблице sphere_account_email (создается автоматически в login БД).

account_list_by_email.title: Accounts by Email
query: SELECT ua.account AS login, CONVERT(varchar(34), au.password, 1) AS password FROM dbo.sphere_account_email AS e JOIN dbo.user_account AS ua ON ua.account = e.account LEFT JOIN dbo.user_auth AS au ON au.account = ua.account WHERE e.email = ?

admin_account_list.title: Admin Account List
query: SELECT e.email AS email, ua.account AS login FROM dbo.user_account AS ua LEFT JOIN dbo.sphere_account_email AS e ON e.account = ua.account ORDER BY ua.account

admin_character_list.title: Admin Character List
query: SELECT account_name, char_name FROM dbo.user_data WHERE account_id > 0

character_items.title: Character Items
query: SELECT item_id AS object_id, item_type AS item_id, amount AS count, enchant AS enchant_level, CASE warehouse WHEN 0 THEN 'INVENTORY' WHEN 1 THEN 'WAREHOUSE' ELSE CAST(warehouse AS varchar(10)) END AS location FROM dbo.user_item WHERE char_id = ? ORDER BY warehouse, item_type

account_create.title: Create Account
query: SET XACT_ABORT ON;
DECLARE @login nvarchar(50) = ?, @password varchar(34) = ?, @email nvarchar(255) = ?;
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
INSERT INTO dbo.user_account (account, pay_stat) VALUES (@login, 1);

INSERT INTO dbo.user_auth (account, password, quiz1, quiz2, answer1, answer2) VALUES (@login, CONVERT(binary(16), @password, 1), 'Question1', 'Question2', CONVERT(binary(16), '0x35D21C03BA011FFACF567070BD270101', 1), CONVERT(binary(16), '0x35D21C03BA011D3B0E97B1B17CE6C0C0', 1));
INSERT INTO dbo.sphere_account_email (account, email) VALUES (@login, @email);
COMMIT TRANSACTION;

account_check_free.title: Check Account Availability
query: SELECT ua.account AS login, CONVERT(varchar(34), au.password, 1) AS password, e.email AS email FROM dbo.user_account AS ua LEFT JOIN dbo.user_auth AS au ON au.account = ua.account LEFT JOIN dbo.sphere_account_email AS e ON e.account = ua.account WHERE ua.account = ?
